service-scrape.label: Annotated metrics Service
service-scrape.description: Let Prometheus find and collect metrics from Pods you already run.

fields.label: Service name
fields.description: A name for the Service. Other apps use it to reach the Pods.

fields.label: Service namespace
fields.description: Must match the namespace of the Pods this Service finds.

fields.label: Pod label key
fields.description: The label name on your metrics Pods, such as app.

fields.label: Pod label value
fields.description: The label value on your metrics Pods.

fields.label: Service port
fields.description: The port other apps use to reach the Service.

fields.label: Target port
fields.description: The port your Pods listen on.

fields.label: Scheme
fields.description: Use http or https to read the metrics.

fields.label: Metrics path
fields.description: The web path where your app shows its metrics.

scrape-job.label: Custom scrape job
scrape-job.description: Tell an existing Prometheus install to collect metrics from one fixed address.

fields.label: Job name
fields.description: A name for this scrape job. It must be unique in this Prometheus install.

fields.label: Scrape interval
fields.description: How often Prometheus collects metrics from the target.

fields.label: Metrics path
fields.description: The web path where the target shows its metrics.

fields.label: Scheme
fields.description: Use http or https to read the metrics.

fields.label: Target address
fields.description: Host and port that Prometheus can reach.

fields.label: Helm release name
fields.description: The Helm release to upgrade. Used in the command.

fields.label: Helm release namespace
fields.description: The namespace of the Helm release. Used in the command.

alert-rule.label: Alert rule
alert-rule.description: Get an alert when a PromQL condition stays true. Adds to an existing Prometheus install.

fields.label: Rule group
fields.description: A name for the group of rules Prometheus checks together.

fields.label: Alert name
fields.description: The alert name you see when it is pending or firing.

fields.label: PromQL expression
fields.description: The PromQL query that finds the problem.

fields.label: Duration
fields.description: How long the problem must last before the alert fires.

fields.label: Severity
fields.description: How urgent the alert is. Used to sort and route alerts.

fields.label: Summary
fields.description: A one-line description shown when the alert fires.
